subject: general
question: Which of the following female mosquitoes acts as a carrier of dengue virus?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aedes.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ​The mosquito** genus Aedes **was first discovered in the **tropical and subtropical regions.**
 
• **Johann Wilhelm Meigen** gave the genus its name in **1818.**
 
• The generic name, **aedes,** means** "odious" or "unpleasant" **in Ancient Greek.
 
• **Dengue virus, yellow fever virus, chikungunya virus, and Zika virus** are all known to be transmitted by Aedes aegypti.
 
• They have **distinct markings** on their **body and legs **in **black and white.**
 
• They only **bite during the daylight** when they are active.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Anopheles:**

 
 
• **J. W. Meigen** initially identified and named the mosquito genus **Anopheles in 1818.**
 
• **Malaria **can only be spread by Anopheles mosquitoes. 
 
 
 
• **Culex:**
 
 
• Culex are also referred to as** common house mosquitoes.**
 
• The viruses that cause** West Nile fever, St. Louis encephalitis, Japanese encephalitis, as well as viral infections of birds and horses**, are conveyed mostly by these carriers.
 
 
 
• **Mansonides:**
 
 
• Mansonides carries **filarial worm**s and produces **larvae and pupae **that get their oxygen from plants submerged in water.
 
• **Venezuelan equine encephalitis** is known to be spread by Mansonia titillans in the** southern United States, Central America, and South America.**
